name: AIKit-Arduino
sentence: One-stop Arduino client for OpenAI-compatible chat completion APIs (DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi, Qwen/DashScope, Zhipu GLM, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenAI...), sync & SSE streaming.
paragraph: Built on StreamHTTPClient and ArduinoJson v7. Vendor presets let you switch providers with one begin() call. Supports system prompt, temperature, max_tokens / max_completion_tokens, custom HTTP headers and custom JSON fields (override or append), TLS root CA or insecure mode, onDelta streaming callback plus a Stream-based line reader, and routed logging to any Print device passed at construction.
note: StreamHTTPClient is not yet published in the Arduino Library Manager; install it from https://github.com/ioqite/StreamHTTPClient (see README).
